summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-illustrations preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a set of SVG illustration assets, and its package.json `files` field whitelists only `illustrations/*.svg` and `CHANGELOG.md`. However, the tarball ships an undeclared 727KB single-line `math_init.js` with hex-mangled identifiers and a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift-array pattern) characteristic of obfuscator.io output. The `preinstall` lifecycle hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/...` into a temp directory, unzips it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the bundled `math_init.js`. Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an undeclared, heavily obfuscated sibling bundle bypasses Node-based scanning and has no relationship to the package's declared purpose of shipping SVG assets. The package uses the `@servicetitan` npm scope and references `github.com/servicetitan/hammer` in its CHANGELOG, but the install-time behavior is inconsistent with a first-party vendor illustrations asset package, indicating scope impersonation or account compromise.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
